loopkeeper.privacy.title: Privacy
loopkeeper.privacy.headline: Your data is yours.
loopkeeper.privacy.subhead: No contact telemetry, no selling of contacts, no cloud copy unless you choose one.
loopkeeper.privacy.pledgeBody: No phone number, email, or identity is required to use LoopKeeper. Anything you share is voluntary. We do not collect personal data — so even if an external AI or forensic scan digs into us, there is no identity trove to find.
loopkeeper.privacy.deviceBody: Your cards, notes and 4-W context live in your device's memory. They do not leave the device unless you choose to sync or share.
loopkeeper.privacy.lockBody: Optional PIN gate on cold start. The PIN is SHA-256 hashed on-device — never sent anywhere. If you forget it, the only reset is clearing app data / reinstalling.
loopkeeper.privacy.cloudBody: When you push to Dropbox, Drive or OneDrive, the bundle is encrypted with your passphrase before it leaves the device. The provider only ever sees ciphertext.
loopkeeper.privacy.shareBody: An invite shares only the moment you chose to send. The rest of the card stays private — LoopKeeper uses your context locally, never as a public profile.
